summary: Senior Manager, Capital & Liquidity Management candidate with ~7 years across institutional balance-sheet risk, ALM, and liquidity analytics. Holds delegated sign-off authority on ALM, valuation, and sensitivity outputs for multi-asset portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement) at Moody's Analytics, where a multi-scenario cash-flow projection and liquidity-gap engine was designed end-to-end. Deep in stress testing, funding analysis, and AI-accelerated modelling. CFA charterholder; dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering.

sections.heading: Capital, Liquidity & Balance-Sheet Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into forecasting to support liquidity planning and contingency analysis.
Oversaw interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, assessing asset risk and balance-sheet sensitivity across multi-asset positions.

sections.heading: Governance, Oversight & Reporting
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing calibration and cross-asset interactions before release.
Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives for non-technical audiences.
Serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Technology & AI Enablement
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

Deployed agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform, translating investment-team requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations across a multi-account migration from the legacy Calypso platform.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program teams on governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes for financial institutions.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for institutional clients, and presented findings to investment committees.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier robustness testing.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
